name: xcode-native
description: Apple's first-party MCP server shipped inside Xcode 26.3 and later. Exposes ~20 tools for file ops, build, Simulator, Previews, and the debugger over XPC into the Xcode process — no separate install.
setup: Requires Xcode 26.3 or newer. Verify with `xcodebuild -version`.
Confirm `xcrun mcpbridge --help` resolves before activating the server in your MCP client.
Pairs well with XcodeBuildMCP — the native server is preview / build-focused; XcodeBuildMCP adds richer test and simulator tooling.
